extraction.Name: Thomas Garcia
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment; but he was going into the Army, and the Indian Agency told him it would be necessary for him to take it, and he did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to Corb. Morse, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $250.00 cash, and four head of horses, valued at $100.00 apiece
extraction.Buyer: Corb. Morse, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $250.00 cash and four head of horses valued at $100.00 apiece
extraction.Occupation/Income: his only income is by doing farm labor
extraction.NOTES: Sold in the fall of 1918. Mentally competent, has good health; is married, and wife's health is frail; has four minor children to support, but their health is good; has never received any help from the County or Government. Document number 7917. Sworn November 17, 1928.
